agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements while granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners. The approval was granted on May 12, 2026, with 99.993% of the votes.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved allocating the 2025 net profit of Rp 1.164 trillion as retained earnings and confirmed that no dividends will be distributed for the fiscal year. This decision received 99.993% approval from shareholders.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a Public Accountant for the 2026 fiscal year audit and to the Board of Directors to determine the associated honorarium. The agenda was approved with 99.107% of the votes.
Agenda #4: The meeting accepted the resignation of Dr. Kartini Syahrir and appointed a new board composition for the 2026-2029 term, including Dr. Yasonna H. Laoly as President Commissioner and David Utama as President Director. The Board of Directors was also granted power of attorney to register these changes and sign necessary legal deeds.
Agenda #5: Shareholders authorized the Board of Commissioners or the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to determine the salaries and allowances for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for the 2026 fiscal year. This delegation of authority was approved with 99.993% of the votes.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the amendment and reaffirmation of Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align the Company's Purposes, Objectives and Business Activities with the Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) and related regulations, including Government Regulation No. 28 of 2025. The amendment was affirmed as administrative and procedural only, with no new or expanded business activities, and passed with 100% of votes in favor (12,304,999,007 shares).
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the Company's plan to acquire shares in companies holding hospital and supporting assets, either through Conditional Share Purchase Agreements or exercise of put options, with a total transaction value of Rp6,908,604,000,000. The resolution passed with 99.862552% of votes in favor, and the Board of Directors was granted full authority to implement the transaction under POJK 17/2020.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved the pledge of Company and subsidiary assets exceeding 50% of net equity to secure a syndicated loan facility of up to Rp14,500,000,000,000 under a loan agreement dated March 24, 2025, as amended and restated on March 31, 2026. The resolution passed with 99.856897% of votes in favor, and the Board of Directors was authorized to execute security documents and perfect the pledge.
